'''Sadollah Nasiri Gheydari''' ({{langx|fa|سعدالله نصیری قیداری}}) is the former President of [[Shahid Beheshti University]] of Tehran. He is a [[physicist]] and [[professor]] at [[Shahid Beheshti University]], Iran.

After obtaining his B.Sc. in 1984, M.Sc. in 1988 and Ph.D. in 1992 under [[Yousef Sobouti]], all from [[Shiraz University]], he continued as associate professor in the Department of Physics of Shiraz University. In 1993, he was transferred to [[Zanjan University]] where he held various positions including head of its Department of Physics from 1994 to 1996, rector of its College of Science from 1996 to 1998 and again from 2002 to 2004, and vice-chancellor of education from 1998 to 2001.

From 2002 to 2006, he was president of the Iranian Astronomical Society and was re-appointed in 2011. In 2008, he was appointed vice president of the Iranian Physical Society.

Gheydari's main research interests relate to [[asteroseismology|oscillations of stars]] in the presence of [[magnetic field]]s, [[quantum mechanics]] in [[phase space]], and [[Coronal heating problem|coronal heating]], as well as the selection of sites for optical [[observatory|observatories]]. His work has included a formulation of quantum mechanics in extended phase space ([[phase space]] in [[Position (vector)|position]] and [[momentum]] extended to include [[time]] and the value of the Hamiltonian as additional phase-space variables<ref>For an overview of extended phase space, see for ex. Jürgen Struckmeier: [http://www.gsi.de/beschleuniger/groups/FSY/veroeffentlichungen_berichte/theorie/extended_phasespace.pdf Hamiltonian mechanics in the "extended" phase space] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120331184547/http://www.gsi.de/beschleuniger/groups/FSY/veroeffentlichungen_berichte/theorie/extended_phasespace.pdf |date=2012-03-31 }}</ref>).

== Selected publications ==
* S. Khademi, S. Nasiri: ''Generalized [[gauge transformation]]s in phase space picture of quantum mechanics: Kirkwood representation'', Journal of Physics: Conference Series vol.&nbsp;128, no.&nbsp;1, 2008, 012016, {{doi|10.1088/1742-6596/128/1/012016}} ([http://iopscience.iop.org/1742-6596/128/1/012016/pdf/1742-6596_128_1_012016.pdf PDF])
* Samira Bahrami, Sadolah Nasiri: ''Symmetry Transformation in Extended Phase Space: the Harmonic Oscillator in the Husimi Representation'', Symmetry Integrability and Geometry Methods and Applications (2008), vol.&nbsp;4, {{doi|10.3842/SIGMA.2008.014}} ([https://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/2008/014/ link]), [https://arxiv.org/abs/0802.0482 arXiv: 0802.0482]
* S. Nasiri: ''[[Quantum potential]] and symmetries in extended phase space'', SIGMA 2 (2006), 062, [https://arxiv.org/abs/quant-ph/0511125 quant-ph/0511125]
* S. Nasiri, S. Khademi, S. Bahrami, F. Taati: ''Generalized distribution functions in extended phase space''. In: V.K. Dobrev (ed.): ''Proceedings QST4'', Heron Press Sofia, 2006, vol.&nbsp;2, pp.&nbsp;820–826
* S. Nasiri, Y. Sobouti, F. Taati: ''Phase space quantum mechanics – direct'', Journal of Mathematical Phys. 47 (2006), 092106, [https://arxiv.org/abs/quant-ph/0605129 quant-ph/0605129]
* S. Nasiri: ''Distribution functions on the light of uncertainty principle'', Jr. Sci. Tech., 29, A2, 259, 2005
* S. Nasiri: ''Path integral approach to quantum state functions'', Jr. Sci. Tech., 4, 3, 1995
* Y. Sobouti, S. Nasiri: ''A phase space formulation of quantum state functions'', International Journal of Modern Physics B, 7 (1993), pp.&nbsp;3255–3272
* Sadollah Nasiri, Samira Bahrami: ''Reality of the [[Wigner quasiprobability distribution|Wigner Function]]s and Quantization'', Research Letters in Physics, vol.&nbsp;2009 (2009), article ID 298790, {{doi|10.1155/2009/298790|doi-access=free}}
